thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 GPU ECC errors high on pool-gpu-us-west-2-02 - 42 ECC corrections in last 1m, 3 nodes flapping

Sara: ack - oncall here, paging in to triage, will attach to the node logs.

Matt: is this the same noisy ECC trend we saw last week?

Sara: looks similar but different host set. nodes: gpu-node-27,gpu-node-28,gpu-node-29. I'm pulling telemetry now.

devops-bot: stackdriver link: https://grafana.example/redwood/d/3g9g/gpu-health?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now

Sara: quick note — routing: some requests are seeing increased latency ~100-500ms on dedicated pools. No full 5xx flood yet.

Olga: adding context: heavy batched workloads started at 03:12 UTC, queue spike on dedicated-1. Could be KV-cache pressure + long sequences.

Matt: starting mitigation: mark gpu-node-29 unschedulable and drain, then reroute critical routes to fallback gpu-variant-v2.

Sara: running:```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-29
kubectl drain gpu-node-29 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# reroute specific routes
rcli route set --route /api/generate --pool gpu-variant-v2 --drain-delay 30s
```

Kevin: I see repeated ECC corrections on gpu-node-27 for mem channel 2. Thermal looks ok, but VRAM pressure 88%. Could be memory errors + saturation.

Olga: pulling dmesg on gpu-node-27: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79" + ECC correction lines. Copying logs to /var/logs/gpu-ecc-1798765432.log

Sara: good. taking node-27 out of rotation as well. draining 27 now.

devops-bot: INCIDENT-1798765432 acknowledged by sara

Nora: pinging infra to check node health requests to provider for potential hardware RMA on node-27/29.

Matt: live mitigation checklist: 1) drain noisy nodes 2) reroute traffic to fallback models 3) temporarily bump concurrency limits for dedicated pools to reduce queueing on remaining nodes 4) adjust alerting so we don't page on single-sample spikes

Sara: implementing 3) and 4) now. For alert tuning I propose: change gpu_ecc_count alert from "critical when count > 10 in 1m" to "warning if > 10 in 1m, critical if > 20 in 5m sustained". Also add median-over-5m for VRAM util to avoid brief spikes.

Matt: +1. Also add a suppression rule during drains so we don't get noise from rebalances.

Olga: quick graph view sent to #eng-sre for calibration.

Sara: applied temporary alert change (config pushed):```yaml
- alert: GPU_ECC_CORRECTIONS
  expr: increase(gpu_ecc_count[5m]) > 20
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
- alert: GPU_ECC_CORRECTIONS_TRANSIENT
  expr: increase(gpu_ecc_count[1m]) > 10
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

Kevin: noted. Also adjusting VRAM threshold: previously fired at 90% instantaneous — changing to 85% 5m avg to catch pressure earlier.

Nora: customer impact update: two dedicated tenants on dedicated-1 saw ~30s tail latency spikes and 4 timeout retries during the drain window. No data loss. I'll open a customer incident note.

Sara: filed internal ticket RDW-INC-2026 and customer note CN-4552.

Matt: handoff — my shift wraps in 20m. Sara staying until stabilized. Who is next oncall?

Nora: Kevin can take second-shift monitoring, I'll coordinate with platform for RMA.

Kevin: taking over monitoring. I'll keep watch on the suppressed alerts and the new dashboard panels.

devops-bot: Reroute completed for /api/generate -> gpu-variant-v2 (policy: immediate failover).

Olga: follow-up ask: can we add a dashboard panel for ECC corrections by memory channel and a small table of nodes with recent ECC counts? Current panels hide channel-level detail.

Sara: noted — creating quick Grafana panel: "GPU ECC by channel (last 1h)" and sharing link. Will craft an alert playbook for threshold rationale.

Matt: Post-incident actions (agreed):
- Create postmortem draft with timeline (owner: sara)
- Update Prometheus alerts: add 5m sustained criteria, warning vs critical split (owner: matt)
- New Grafana panel for ECC channels & VRAM 5m median (owner: olga)
- RMA request for gpu-node-27/29 if additional ECCs in next 24h (owner: nora)
- Customer comms draft (owner: kevin)

Sara: assigning owners in JIRA RDW-1798765432-POSTMORTEM. Adding playbook snippet for drain suppression and how to re-enable alerts after maintenance.

Kevin: quick PS — please update the alert docs with the rationale: ECC corrections can be noisy from transient radiation bursts; we want to avoid paging on short bursts but still catch hardware regressions.

Olga: FYI: I'll also add a metric for "ECC rate per 10k hours" for longer-term trend tracking.

Matt: thanks team. Reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:

sara: ending the live thread — leaving monitoring to kevin for the next 2h, will review postmortem draft in the morning.

devops-bot: Incident 1798765432 resolved (nodes drained, alerts tuned).

kevin: ack, watching.

nora: created customer note CN-4552 and linked to RDW-1798765432-POSTMORTEM.

Sara: closing thread, will bump to #incidents with postmortem link once draft is ready.
